params.name: Locust
params.note: An Air Tractor AT-802: a long slim PT6 cowl with its exhaust stacks bent back, the chemical hopper as a hump ahead of a tall glass cockpit set high for seeing the ground in a turn, a wire cutter on the windscreen and a deflector cable to the fin, a straight low wing with a spray boom and nozzles along its trailing edge and a wind-driven pump under the belly, spring-steel gear on fat tyres, and a braced tail.
